skill.name: production-readiness
skill.description: Pre-deployment validation for code quality, security, performance, documentation, dependencies, and rollback readiness.
skill.summary: Validate release readiness with deployment gates, audit checks, and a structured rollout checklist.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: The audit found many false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline command references, and documented shell reporting logic. One static finding is confirmed because the secret keyword scan can print sensitive source lines, and one semantic finding covers unpinned npx-based CLI execution.

remediation.issue: Secret keyword scan can reveal credential values.
remediation.suggestion: Redact matched values before printing results, or report only file paths, line numbers, and rule names.

remediation.issue: npx commands are not pinned to a trusted package version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin claude-flow to a verified version, document the package source, and require explicit confirmation before running it.

remediation.issue: The shell workflow scans user-supplied target paths.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the target path, keep variables quoted, and warn users before scanning directories outside the project root.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned External CLI Execution
semantic_findings.description: The readiness workflow runs npx claude-flow commands without a pinned package version or install-source constraint. npx may download and execute package code during an audit, which creates supply-chain and local execution risk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file directly instructs use of npx for claude-flow audit, security, performance, and bottleneck commands. The commands are legitimate for this skill, but the lack of version pinning leaves a clear supply-chain exposure.

content.value_statement: Production releases can fail when quality, security, documentation, and rollback checks happen late. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured pre-deployment audit.
actual_capabilities: Runs a staged readiness workflow across tests, quality, coverage, security, performance, documentation, dependencies, and monitoring.
Generates a deployment checklist with gate status, sign-off items, deployment steps, and rollback steps.
Checks for required release documents, including README, deployment guidance, and rollback plans.
Uses local project reports to calculate pass or fail status for deployment gates.
Scans source files for common secret keywords and logging framework indicators.
Supports production and staging modes with an option to skip performance checks.
limitations: Requires local shell access and expected command-line tools to be available.
The workflow assumes JavaScript or TypeScript projects for several source scans.
Performance checks depend on available benchmark data and may not represent real production traffic.
Secret scanning is keyword-based and can miss encoded, renamed, or externally stored secrets.

use_cases.title: Release Manager Gate Review
use_cases.description: Validate that release gates pass before approving a production deployment.

use_cases.title: Developer Preflight Check
use_cases.description: Run a local readiness review before requesting deployment approval.

use_cases.title: DevOps Rollout Preparation
use_cases.description: Create a checklist that covers deployment steps, monitoring, sign-offs, and rollback tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Readiness Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner release check for a project directory.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the production-readiness skill to review this project for production deployment. Focus on tests, documentation, security, and clear blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Staging Deployment Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess production readiness for the staging environment. Identify warnings separately from blockers and create a short action list.

prompt_templates.title: Production Gate Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release gate assessment before production.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a strict production readiness review. Include quality gates, security concerns, performance status, required documents, and deployment sign-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Release Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced follow-up after failed readiness checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the failed readiness results and produce a prioritized remediation plan with owners, severity, verification steps, and rollback considerations.

output_examples.input: Review a service before production deployment.
output: Deployment is not ready because security and documentation gates failed.
Blocking actions include fixing high-severity findings and adding a rollback plan.
Warnings include missing load test evidence and incomplete monitoring sign-off.

output_examples.input: Create a readiness checklist for a staging release.
output: Checklist covers tests, coverage, dependency review, staging smoke tests, deployment owner, and rollback owner.
Staging may proceed after documentation warnings are accepted by the release owner.

output_examples.input: Explain why a production gate failed.
output: The quality gate failed because coverage is below the required threshold.
The security gate failed because unresolved high-severity issues remain.
Deployment should wait until both gates pass and sign-offs are recorded.

best_practices: Run the skill from the project root so file and documentation checks use the correct scope.
Review command output before sharing reports because scans may reveal sensitive file names or values.
Keep release thresholds, service-level objectives, and rollback ownership documented before the final audit.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a generated checklist as approval without human sign-off.
Do not run secret scans on directories that include unrelated private repositories.
Do not skip performance checks for production unless a release owner accepts the risk.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy the application?
faq.answer: No. It checks readiness and creates deployment guidance, but deployment remains a separate action.

faq.question: Can it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. It can surface common issues, but high-risk releases still need security team review.

faq.question: Which project types fit best?
faq.answer: It fits JavaScript and TypeScript services best because several checks target those file types.

faq.question: Can performance checks be skipped?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes a skip option, but production releases should document the accepted risk.

faq.question: Does it read environment files?
faq.answer: The documented workflow checks whether environment example files exist. It should not print real environment values.

faq.question: What does the final output include?
faq.answer: It includes gate status, blockers, warnings, deployment tasks, sign-off items, and rollback guidance.
